name: general_light_curve_benchmark_dataset_collection_moa_microlensing_dataset
description: A collection of light-curve datasets from the MOA microlensing survey intended to benchmark algorithms for detecting and characterizing microlensing events from time-series photometry. It measures classification/detection performance on astrophysical transient (microlensing) signals under realistic survey conditions.
evaluation_method: F1 / precision-recall (event detection metrics; ROC AUC commonly reported)
general_score_metric: F1 (often supplemented by precision/recall and ROC AUC)
reputation: A domain-specific astrophysics benchmark used by researchers working on transient detection and time-series analysis; moderate adoption within the astronomy community.
